stories.title: 'Forget telecast, nobody knew we were a cricket team' - PNG head coach
stories.subTitle: ICC Under-19 World Cup 2018
stories.seoTitle: 'Forget telecast, nobody knew we were a cricket team' - PNG head coach
stories.summary: PNG will be playing a match that will be televised back home for only the second time ever and their head coach Kila Pala and the cricket board are doing all they can to make sure the kids have fun
